facts.fact: Run stopped by restart offers Resume on step line and in Needs you tab (item kind "stuck run", action text "Resume").
Clicking Resume on stuck run calls IPC channel adeTaskResumeRun exactly once with args { runId } of that run.
Resumed run that has finished shows no Resume button.
Run with lost conversation shows its reason (note containing 'could not resume') and Retry button, no Resume button.
When Resume request refused, error message shown on step in stage block's error element.
In e2e test fixture board, T_cart release run (r_T_cart_release_b_cart) takes state, note, resumable flag and outcome from 'ade-resume' contract run (AdeTaskService.Run#<key>).
Backend half of ade-resume e2e test: flows/adeflow TestResumeAfterRestart and TestResumeLostConversation.
